title: Roadstorm shared AI observation record (observation schema version 1)
description: Machine-readable contract for one AIObservation assembled by the ObservationBuilder and consumed by a Classic planner or a Roadstormer learned policy through the shared observation/intent/follower hierarchy (docs/OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1', 'Architecture' step 1; the 'AIObservation/TacticalIntent' row of docs/TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md 'Content contracts': version, ordered shape/fields, road frame, masks, observation age, normalization, personality/difficulty and reset defaults, defined before M4.2). This is a text contract defined at M0.9. It requires no working AI implementation and defines no model, weights, export, training or inference interface; those are ratified separately at M4B and are deliberately absent here. Every field, index, mask, normalization coefficient, age rule and reset rule below restates semantics specified in docs/OPPONENT_AI.md. This slice is DISTINCT from the partial, unaccepted schemas/ai_observation.schema.json and from the other schema slices; that file is not superseded or edited here. Values that the documents leave undetermined are JSON null in instances and MUST be listed in the enclosing fixture's 'unknowns' (see observation_fixture.schema.json).

schema_version.description: Contract revision. A record whose schema_version differs is rejected, not silently migrated; a contract change requires a new version and a recorded decision.

observation_layout_revision.description: Feature-layout revision of the shared 64-element vector, parallel to intent_layout_revision in tactical_intent.schema.json. 'ai_shared_v1' names the OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1' layout; a layout change is a new revision and a recorded decision.

feature_count.description: The shared observation is a fixed 64-element float32 vector in a documented order.

observation_id.description: Stable ID of this observation record, e.g. obs.t000996.ai_surge_1.

difficulty.description: Explicit difficulty input to the policy. Selects the delayed traffic age (18/12/7 ticks at 60 Hz) encoded in indices 57-59.

style.description: Explicit style input to the policy, encoded in indices 60-61. 'surge'/'switch' are the two learned styles; 'none' is the Classic-only style input pair 0/0 (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1').

road_frame.description: Route frame is forward tangent, right lateral, up road normal; positive lane offset is right (same convention as tactical_intent.schema.json). The strings name the frame's axes; concrete vectors are runtime state, not frozen here.

tactical_rate_hz.description: Tactical decision rate this observation feeds. OPPONENT_AI.md specifies 'initially' 5 Hz; changing it requires a new schema_version and a recorded decision.

period_ticks.description: Sampling period in 60 Hz ticks (5 Hz).

sampling.description: Observations feed the 5 Hz tactical decision. Ego and road-ahead features are current as of sampled_tick; neighbor traffic, corridor occupancy and traffic-derived history use the delayed snapshot at traffic_snapshot_tick; the immediate emergency guard remains current and is not part of this vector.

sampled_tick.description: 60 Hz simulation tick at which this observation was assembled. Ego (0-11) and road-ahead (12-26) features reflect committed state at this tick.

traffic_snapshot_tick.description: 60 Hz tick of the delayed traffic snapshot used for neighbor (27-50), occupancy (62-63) and traffic-derived history features. traffic_age_ticks = sampled_tick - traffic_snapshot_tick.

traffic_age_ticks.description: Age of the delayed traffic snapshot: Rookie 18, Racer 12, Expert 7 ticks at 60 Hz (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1'). Must equal sampled_tick - traffic_snapshot_tick, and must equal the declared difficulty default unless the enclosing fixture sets context.traffic_age_is_difficulty_default false, which marks a deliberate non-default age scenario that the fixture description must explain (the validator enforces the arithmetic and, when the flag is true, the difficulty default; it cannot machine-check the prose explanation).

feature_vector.description: The 64 normalized features in fixed index order (see feature_layout). All values are finite float32 clipped to [-1,1]; booleans/one-hots/flags are 0/1; corridor-occupancy fractions are clipped to [0,1].

raw_inputs.description: OPTIONAL. Pre-normalization physical values for a representative subset of ratio features, keyed by the decimal index string (e.g. "0", "27"). The validator recomputes clip(raw <op> scale) from $defs.constants and the fixture context and requires it to equal feature_vector[index] within tolerance. Absent when the record does not pin raw sensor values (e.g. a safe-fallback record).

neighbor_slots.description: Presence mask per neighbor slot, mirroring the in-vector presence-mask features at indices 32/38/44/50. Must agree with them exactly.

history_valid.description: 1 when the history features (51-56) carry valid data; 0 when they are masked to zero/default after a reset ('Preserve feature timestamps and reset history to zero/masked defaults'). The safe diagnostic fallback also masks history without a reset (reset_generation 0, post_reset_defaults_applied false), as in fixture.observation.fallback_zero_width; whether a fallback must additionally bump reset_generation is unratified and recorded in that fixture's unknowns, so 0 without a reset is accepted, not rejected.

reset_generation.description: Counts participant resets/recoveries. Reset restores timers, counters, history, contact/recovery state and queued events (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Training approach'; TECHNICAL_DESIGN fixed-tick reset), so the generation makes observation history comparable across resets.

post_reset_defaults_applied.description: true when this observation was assembled after a reset with masked history defaults substituted; then masks.history_valid must be 0, reset_generation must be at least 1, and defaults_applied must list the substituted defaults.

defaults_applied.description: Feature names or group names from feature_layout (e.g. 'history_lane_target_0p2s' or 'history') reverted to masked defaults after the reset; non-empty when post_reset_defaults_applied is true. Every entry must name a layout feature or group; the validator rejects unknown names.

coefficients_revision.description: Revision of the normalization coefficients (the /20, /pi, x100, /0.12, /70 ... divisors/multipliers in $defs.constants). Clipping/padding rules and every normalization coefficient ship with the model (OPPONENT_AI.md); a coefficient change is a new revision.

active.description: true when the safe diagnostic fallback fired: unknown schema, zero usable width, or nonfinite input produces a safe diagnostic fallback (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1').

reason.description: Why the fallback fired; non-empty when active.

defaults_applied.description: Which defaults the fallback substituted; non-empty when active.

occupancy_encounter_gap_m.description: Signed route gap (m, positive ahead) at which the delayed left/right corridor-occupancy fractions (indices 62-63) are evaluated - the 'planned encounter'. OPPONENT_AI.md specifies occupancy 'at the planned encounter' but does not fix the encounter distance, so this is null until ratified; a null requires a matching unknowns entry.

feature_layout.description: The ordered 64-feature specification as machine-readable DATA (not a schema). Order and normalization are from OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1'. The fixtures/observation validator reads this array to drive the normalization_consistency check, to enforce each entry's declared kind and range, and to confirm index/group spans; it is the single source of truth for the vector order. kind: ratio_divide=clip(raw/scale), ratio_multiply=clip(raw*scale), boolean/one_hot=0/1, fraction=clip[0,1], signed_enum=-1/0/1, already_normalized=value already in [-1,1]. scale_ref names a member of $defs.constants.normalization_scales, or a fixture-context member (top_speed_m_s, usable_half_width_m); null for non-ratio kinds. snapshot: current=committed state at sampled_tick; delayed=the delayed traffic snapshot at traffic_snapshot_tick. A present neighbor's route gap (indices 27/33/39/45) must lie inside $defs.constants' 70 m ahead / 35 m behind window, which the validator enforces.

features.name: history_lane_target_0p2s
features.normalization: own executed normalized lane target at 0.2 s ago (recorded normalized value)

features.name: history_lane_target_0p6s
features.normalization: own executed normalized lane target at 0.6 s ago (recorded normalized value)

features.name: history_forward_distance_3s
features.normalization: valid forward distance over last 3 s / 195 m

features.name: history_recent_contact
features.normalization: recent contact flag (prior 2 s ending at delayed traffic timestamp)

features.name: occupancy_left_fraction
features.normalization: delayed left corridor occupancy fraction at the planned encounter, clipped 0-1

features.name: occupancy_right_fraction
features.normalization: delayed right corridor occupancy fraction at the planned encounter, clipped 0-1

constants.description: Single source of truth for the numeric semantics of this contract, all from docs/OPPONENT_AI.md. The fixtures/observation validator reads these instead of restating them.

neighbor_ahead_m.description: Neighbor candidates are within 70 m ahead on the valid route neighborhood.

neighbor_behind_m.description: Neighbor candidates are within 35 m behind on the valid route neighborhood.

history_recent_window_s.description: The recent contact flag and traffic-derived pass/occupancy history cover the prior two seconds ending at the delayed traffic timestamp.

normalization_scales.description: Fixed normalization divisors/multipliers from the OPPONENT_AI.md feature table. top_speed_m_s (index 0) and usable_half_width_m (index 4) are per-car/per-section and are supplied by the fixture context, not fixed here.
